Composition/framing: square 1:1, fixed straight front camera slightly above the tabletop, 85mm product-photography perspective, no wide-angle distortion. The very soft wall/table boundary runs perfectly horizontal at y=82% of image height; only the bottom 18% is the tabletop upper surface. Table continues out of the bottom edge; NO visible vertical front edge or front face. The middle 80% of image width and upper 80% of image height are empty clean wall for later flower compositing. Full-frame image edge to edge, no frame.
Lighting/mood: the same beautiful warm raking light from upper left as the reference, a large window-sized soft source giving tactile fine physical surface detail, smooth natural tonal falloff, soft right-side reflected fill, no blown highlights. Restrained elegant low saturation, cinematic editorial still-life realism.

Absolutely no flowers, no branches, no greenery, no vase, no pottery, no furniture detail, no props, no window frame, no window grid shadows, no tree or leaf shadow, no pattern or text, no logo, watermark, UI or borders.
